posts.label: Carousel 1

slides.title: Things no one told you about going home for the holidays
slides.body: The list they should have given us.

slides.title: “I’m still figuring it out” is a complete sentence
slides.body: Your aunt doesn’t need a five-year plan from you. Neither do you, actually.

slides.title: You will walk into your childhood bedroom and feel 16
slides.body: This doesn’t mean you haven’t grown. It means you have a past.

slides.title: Clear nail polish stops a run in your tights
slides.body: Dab it over the snag before it goes further. Works every time.

slides.title: The person asking about your love life is usually just nervous
slides.body: Awkward questions at the table are rarely about you. Usually they don’t know what else to say.

slides.title: “Grateful” and “this is hard” can both be true at the same table
slides.body: You don’t have to perform thankfulness to actually feel it.

slides.title: What’s one thing you want to leave at the table this year — not bring back home with you?
